<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, ComponentPublicInstance, HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { computed, ref, toRef, watch } from 'vue'
import { getElement, getNextSelection, isEqual, provideTagsInputRootContext } from '.'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap | Component
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  modelValue?: any[] | null
  defaultValue?: any[]
  /** Adds the tags of a pasted text, split at `delimiter`. */
  addOnPaste?: boolean
  addOnTab?: boolean
  addOnBlur?: boolean
  duplicate?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  delimiter?: string | RegExp
  dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'
  /** 0 means no limit. */
  max?: number
  /** The `id` of the text input. */
  id?: string
  convertValue?: (value: string) => any
  displayValue?: (value: any) => string
  name?: string
}>(), {
  as: 'div',
  defaultValue: () => [],
  delimiter: ',',
  max: 0,
  displayValue: (value: any) => value.toString(),
})

const emits = defineEmits<{
  'update:modelValue': [value: any[]]
  'invalid': [payload: any]
  'addTag': [payload: any]
  'removeTag': [payload: any]
}>()

// The tags change at once, so more than one change in a tick, such as a paste, all count.
const localValue = ref<any[]>([...(props.modelValue ?? props.defaultValue)])
const modelValue = computed<any[]>({
  get: () => localValue.value,
  set: (value) => {
    localValue.value = value
    emits('update:modelValue', value)
  },
})

watch(() => props.modelValue, (value) => {
  if (value !== undefined) {
    localValue.value = value ?? []
  }
}, { deep: true })

const rootElement = ref<ComponentPublicInstance | HTMLElement | null>(null)
const selectedElement = ref<HTMLElement>()
const isInvalidInput = ref(false)
const focused = ref(false)
const items = new Map<HTMLElement, () => any>()

function direction() {
  const element = getElement(rootElement.value)

  return props.dir ?? (element && getComputedStyle(element).direction === 'rtl' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr')
}

function getItems() {
  return Array.from(items.keys())
    .filter(element => element.dataset.disabled !== '')
    .sort((first, second) => first.compareDocumentPosition(second) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING ? -1 : 1)
}

function removeTag(index: number) {
  if (index === -1) {
    return
  }

  const removed = modelValue.value[index]

  modelValue.value = modelValue.value.filter((_, position) => position !== index)
  emits('removeTag', removed)
}

function addTag(typed: any) {
  const current = [...modelValue.value]

  if (current.some(tag => typeof tag === 'object' && tag !== null) && typeof props.convertValue !== 'function') {
    throw new TypeError('`convertValue` is required when the tags are objects.')
  }

  const payload = props.convertValue ? props.convertValue(typed) : typed

  if (props.max && current.length >= props.max) {
    emits('invalid', payload)
    return false
  }

  if (props.duplicate || !current.some(tag => isEqual(tag, payload))) {
    modelValue.value = [...current, payload]
    emits('addTag', payload)
    return true
  }

  isInvalidInput.value = true
  emits('invalid', payload)
  return false
}

function onInputKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.isComposing) {
    return
  }

  const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement
  const collection = getItems()
  const lastTag = collection.at(-1)

  if (!lastTag) {
    return
  }

  switch (event.key) {
    case 'Delete':
    case 'Backspace': {
      if (target.selectionStart !== 0 || target.selectionEnd !== 0) {
        break
      }

      if (selectedElement.value) {
        const index = collection.indexOf(selectedElement.value)
        const value = items.get(selectedElement.value)?.()

        removeTag(modelValue.value.findIndex(tag => isEqual(tag, value)))
        selectedElement.value = selectedElement.value === lastTag
          ? (index > 0 ? collection[index - 1] : undefined)
          : collection[index + 1]
        event.preventDefault()
      }
      else if (event.key === 'Backspace') {
        selectedElement.value = lastTag
        event.preventDefault()
      }
      break
    }
    case 'Home':
    case 'End':
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'ArrowLeft': {
      if (target.selectionStart !== 0 || target.selectionEnd !== 0) {
        break
      }

      const dir = direction()
      const isArrowRight = (event.key === 'ArrowRight' && dir === 'ltr') || (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' && dir === 'rtl')

      if (!isArrowRight && !selectedElement.value) {
        selectedElement.value = lastTag
        event.preventDefault()
      }
      else if (isArrowRight && selectedElement.value === lastTag) {
        selectedElement.value = undefined
        event.preventDefault()
      }
      else if (selectedElement.value) {
        selectedElement.value = getNextSelection(event.key, selectedElement.value, collection, dir)
        event.preventDefault()
      }
      break
    }
    case 'ArrowUp':
    case 'ArrowDown': {
      if (selectedElement.value) {
        event.preventDefault()
      }
      break
    }
    default:
      selectedElement.value = undefined
  }
}

provideTagsInputRootContext({
  modelValue,
  onAddValue: addTag,
  onRemoveValue: removeTag,
  onInputKeydown,
  registerItem(element, value) {
    items.set(element, value)

    return () => {
      items.delete(element)
    }
  },
  selectedElement,
  isInvalidInput,
  addOnPaste: toRef(props, 'addOnPaste'),
  addOnBlur: toRef(props, 'addOnBlur'),
  addOnTab: toRef(props, 'addOnTab'),
  disabled: toRef(props, 'disabled'),
  delimiter: toRef(props, 'delimiter'),
  id: toRef(props, 'id'),
  displayValue: props.displayValue,
})

function onFocusout(event: FocusEvent) {
  if (!getElement(rootElement.value)?.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) {
    focused.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    ref="rootElement"
    data-slot="tags-input"
    :dir="props.dir"
    :data-invalid="isInvalidInput ? '' : undefined"
    :data-disabled="disabled ? '' : undefined"
    :data-focused="focused ? '' : undefined"
    :class="cn(
      'flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none',
      'focus-within:border-ring focus-within:ring-ring/50 focus-within:ring-3',
      'aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive',
      props.class)"
    @focusin="focused = true"
    @focusout="onFocusout"
  >
    <slot :model-value="modelValue" />
    <template v-if="name">
      <input
        v-for="(tag, index) in modelValue"
        :key="index"
        type="hidden"
        :name="name"
        :value="typeof tag === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(tag) : tag"
        :disabled="disabled"
      >
    </template>
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { nextTick, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { injectTagsInputRootContext } from '.'

const props = defineProps<{
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  autoFocus?: boolean
  maxLength?: number
}>()

const context = injectTagsInputRootContext()

const inputElement = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)
let composing = false

function handleBlur(event: FocusEvent) {
  context.selectedElement.value = undefined

  if (!context.addOnBlur.value) {
    return
  }

  const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement
  const controlledId = target.getAttribute('aria-controls')

  // A click on the list that the input controls is not a blur of the field.
  if (controlledId && (event.relatedTarget as HTMLElement | null)?.closest(`#${CSS.escape(controlledId)}`)) {
    return
  }

  if (target.value && context.onAddValue(target.value)) {
    target.value = ''
  }
}

async function handleKey(event: KeyboardEvent, preventImplicitSubmit: boolean) {
  if (composing) {
    return
  }

  let preventedByOthers = event.defaultPrevented
  const preventDefault = event.preventDefault.bind(event)

  event.preventDefault = () => {
    preventedByOthers = true
    preventDefault()
  }

  const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement

  // Enter in a form submits it, so keep the text for the tag.
  if (preventImplicitSubmit && target.value && !preventedByOthers) {
    preventDefault()
  }

  // Let other handlers of the same key, such as a suggestion list, prevent the tag.
  await nextTick()

  if (preventedByOthers || !target.value) {
    return
  }

  if (context.onAddValue(target.value)) {
    target.value = ''
  }

  preventDefault()
}

function handleTab(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (context.addOnTab.value) {
    return handleKey(event, false)
  }
}

function handleInput(event: Event) {
  if (composing) {
    return
  }

  context.isInvalidInput.value = false

  const { data } = event as InputEvent

  if (data === null) {
    return
  }

  const delimiter = context.delimiter.value
  const matchesDelimiter = delimiter === data || (delimiter instanceof RegExp && delimiter.test(data))

  if (!matchesDelimiter) {
    return
  }

  const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement

  target.value = target.value.replace(delimiter, '')

  if (target.value.trim() === '') {
    target.value = ''
    return
  }

  if (context.onAddValue(target.value)) {
    target.value = ''
  }
}

function handlePaste(event: ClipboardEvent) {
  if (!context.addOnPaste.value) {
    return
  }

  event.preventDefault()

  const text = event.clipboardData?.getData('text')

  if (text === undefined) {
    return
  }

  if (context.delimiter.value) {
    text.split(context.delimiter.value).forEach(value => context.onAddValue(value))
  }
  else {
    context.onAddValue(text)
  }
}

function handleCompositionStart() {
  composing = true
}

function handleCompositionEnd() {
  // Safari sends the key that ends a composition after `compositionend`.
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    composing = false
  })
}

onMounted(() => {
  if (props.autoFocus) {
    setTimeout(() => inputElement.value?.focus(), 1)
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <input
    :id="context.id.value"
    ref="inputElement"
    data-slot="tags-input-input"
    type="text"
    autocomplete="off"
    autocorrect="off"
    autocapitalize="off"
    :maxlength="maxLength"
    :disabled="context.disabled.value"
    :data-invalid="context.isInvalidInput.value ? '' : undefined"
    :class="cn('text-sm min-h-5 focus:outline-none flex-1 bg-transparent px-1', props.class)"
    @input="handleInput"
    @keydown.enter="handleKey($event, true)"
    @keydown.tab="handleTab"
    @keydown="context.onInputKeydown"
    @blur="handleBlur"
    @compositionstart="handleCompositionStart"
    @compositionend="handleCompositionEnd"
    @paste="handlePaste"
  >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, ComponentPublicInstance, HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef, toRef } from 'vue'
import { getElement, injectTagsInputRootContext, provideTagsInputItemContext } from '.'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap | Component
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  value: any
  disabled?: boolean
}>(), {
  as: 'div',
})

const context = injectTagsInputRootContext()

const itemRef = ref<ComponentPublicInstance | HTMLElement | null>(null)
const element = shallowRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)
const value = toRef(props, 'value')
const isSelected = computed(() => !!element.value && context.selectedElement.value === element.value)
const disabled = computed(() => props.disabled || context.disabled.value)
const itemContext = provideTagsInputItemContext({
  value,
  isSelected,
  disabled,
  textId: ref(undefined),
  displayValue: computed(() => context.displayValue(value.value)),
})

let unregister: (() => void) | undefined

onMounted(() => {
  element.value = getElement(itemRef.value)

  if (element.value) {
    unregister = context.registerItem(element.value, () => value.value)
  }
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => unregister?.())
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    ref="itemRef"
    data-slot="tags-input-item"
    :aria-labelledby="itemContext.textId.value"
    :aria-current="isSelected"
    :data-disabled="disabled ? '' : undefined"
    :data-state="isSelected ? 'active' : 'inactive'"
    :class="cn('flex h-5 items-center rounded-md bg-secondary data-[state=active]:ring-ring data-[state=active]:ring-2 data-[state=active]:ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'

import { XIcon } from '@lucide/vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { injectTagsInputItemContext, injectTagsInputRootContext, isEqual } from '.'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap | Component
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>(), {
  as: 'button',
})

const context = injectTagsInputRootContext()
const itemContext = injectTagsInputItemContext()

const disabled = computed(() => itemContext.disabled.value || context.disabled.value)

function handleDelete() {
  if (disabled.value) {
    return
  }

  context.onRemoveValue(context.modelValue.value.findIndex(tag => isEqual(tag, itemContext.value.value)))
}
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    data-slot="tags-input-item-delete"
    tabindex="-1"
    :aria-labelledby="itemContext.textId.value"
    :aria-current="itemContext.isSelected.value"
    :data-state="itemContext.isSelected.value ? 'active' : 'inactive'"
    :data-disabled="disabled ? '' : undefined"
    :type="as === 'button' ? 'button' : undefined"
    :class="cn('flex rounded bg-transparent mr-1', props.class)"
    @click="handleDelete"
  >
    <slot>
      <XIcon class="w-4 h-4" />
    </slot>
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { useId } from 'vue'
import { injectTagsInputItemContext } from '.'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap | Component
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>(), {
  as: 'span',
})

const itemContext = injectTagsInputItemContext()

itemContext.textId.value ||= useId()
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    :id="itemContext.textId.value"
    data-slot="tags-input-item-text"
    :class="cn('py-0.5 px-2 text-sm rounded bg-transparent', props.class)"
  >
    <slot>{{ itemContext.displayValue.value }}</slot>
  </component>
</template>
